FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Haven Realty Group, we specialize in providing comprehensive real estate services, focusing exclusively on residential property sales and listings. Our operations encompass facilitating property transactions, engaging in detailed market analysis, and delivering exceptional client support throughout the buying and selling processes. We prioritize compliance with all applicable real estate laws and regulations, ensuring that our clients receive accurate information and secure transactions. Our team of experienced agents employs advanced technology for transaction management, enabling streamlined communications and efficient service delivery while maintaining a commitment to high ethical standards and transparency. We do not engage in property development, construction management, or active property management, which helps us mitigate potential liabilities and concentrate on our core mission of connecting buyers and sellers effectively.

Our agency specializes in facilitating property development and provides comprehensive management services for residential and commercial properties, ensuring that all aspects of construction and active property oversight are expertly handled.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Haven Realty Group does not engage in operations involving the storage, treatment, discharge, application, disposal, or transportation of hazardous materials, as our focus is solely on residential property sales and transactions.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Haven Realty Group does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is primarily on residential real estate services and transactions.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this ensures proper risk transfer and liability coverage. The agency is responsible for checking these certificates to maintain compliance and mitigate risk.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Haven Realty Group has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes connected to this or any other property. We maintain strict compliance with ethical standards in our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Haven Realty Group has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. Our focus on residential property sales and adherence to compliance standards has kept us in good standing with insurance providers.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Haven Realty Group does not lease employees to or from other employers as our focus is strictly on residential real estate services. We employ all staff directly to ensure compliance and maintain our service quality.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Coverage is not available for agencies engaged in property development, construction management, or active property management. Therefore, workers' compensation cannot be obtained for such activities.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Haven Realty Group does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is exclusively on providing residential real estate services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Haven Realty Group does not have any other insurance with this company as coverage is not available for agencies engaged in property development, construction management, or active property management.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Haven Realty Group does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our focus is strictly on residential real estate services and transactions.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Haven Realty Group does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus exclusively on residential real estate services without engaging in equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Haven Realty Group has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens in the past five years. We maintain a strong financial standing to support our operations in residential real estate services.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Haven Realty Group does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our focus is solely on residential property sales and transactions, which do not involve such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Coverage is not available for agencies like Haven Realty Group that are engaged in property development, construction management, or active property management, which presents higher liability risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Haven Realty Group has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical standards and compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Haven Realty Group does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, as we prioritize compliance with all relevant safety regulations.
